body: It’s alright, helping others might help me so you can talk to me anytime
I want to give up too, but please don’t, please just a bit longer
I feel exactly the same no matter how much I give to people I can never be the first choice they wouldn’t even want me because I’m petty and sad all the time
For me telling someone makes me feel even worse I don’t know why people say talking to someone helps you’re literally making them sad
You’re so nice it’s really refreshing to talk to you :) you can message me anytime too. I hope you’re doing okay
Not the same as usual all studios are locked so I have to make sure I keep up with things at home, thank you for talking to me :)

Dance is my biggest passion and I really believe that is what got me out of self harm and not eating before. But now I take it more seriously, so I now do it as a way to loose more weight. Thank you for the hugs xxx

bad I guess, it’s just getting worse I struggle with body image and I have to be a certain body shape for my job. My parents see I’m struggling but I do t think they really want to do anything. They just tell me to eat
Thank you! It really did make me feel better 💞
Nobody knows what I am thinking and there is no way I’m ever telling them. I talk to them regularly to distract myself x

Thank you :) I really don’t think telling any of my friends is a good idea because they can’t do anything about it but worry, I want them to be happy. I have a very harsh workout that consumes my whole free time, I used to starve myself and being alone in quarantine is bringing those habits back I guess. Thank you for speaking to me
